Messages.Author: Rob Treasure
Messages.Body:
Something that has come up a lot lately in our playgroup.

Most recently one of our number created a monster with Aching Beauty and
Change of Targets which posed the question of requirements.

1. Anson had 2 aching beauties on him (and was due for some more) and was
quite rightly deranged - do the aching beauties still kick in even though
his is now a raving nutter ?

2. This also applies to a few other cards, (most of which escape me) Sword
of Judgement is one. Does the same rule apply to all of them or do masters
have different requirements than minion cards ??

Thanks

Rob T

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Rob Treasure wrote:
>
> Something that has come up a lot lately in our playgroup.
>
> Most recently one of our number created a monster with Aching Beauty and
> Change of Targets which posed the question of requirements.
>
> 1. Anson had 2 aching beauties on him (and was due for some more) and was
> quite rightly deranged - do the aching beauties still kick in even though
> his is now a raving nutter ?

No. Card text on Aching Beauty says that the controller of the blocker
burn a pool when "this Toreador is blocked". Since he is not a Toreador,
no effect occurs.

> 2. This also applies to a few other cards, (most of which escape me) Sword
> of Judgement is one. Does the same rule apply to all of them or do masters
> have different requirements than minion cards ??

Master/minion doesn't matter. Card text is all that matters for these cases.
If it says "this vampire", then it applies even if the vampire changes clan.
If it says "this Brujah Antitribu", then it only applies when "this vampire"
is a Brujah Antitribu.

The clan symbol (if any) on the card is only "checked" when the card is
played. Once in play, card text determines how the card functions.
